content.text:
Repaired and resubmitted.

**What changed:** I added a second operation conforming the proviso in Section 9.0(f) so the carve-outs match the now-bilateral restriction — the chapeau becomes "either party", the limb references to IBM become "that party"/"such party", and the dangling "such Transferred Employees" (which lost its antecedent when the operative scope changed) becomes "such personnel". Operation 1 is unchanged: mutual restriction, scope limited to the other party's personnel directly involved in performing the Agreement, 12 months from the end of that involvement.

**Coverage:** mutuality, involvement-based scope and the 12-month/involvement-end anchor map to operation 1; the general-advertising and unsolicited-approach exclusions now map to operation 2 in operative language; the no-hire element remains already met by the retained solicitation-only formulation ("in any way solicit for employment any"). Minimality passed with no added survival, expense or procedural language.
